source: A register file can be large in aggregate and still become a constraint because thousands of resident threads share it. ZXNAME0000XZ’s current compute-capability tables list 64K 32-bit registers per ZXNAME0001XZ for several recent architectures, while Hopper H100 allows at most 255 registers per thread.[4][5]
zh: 寄存器文件总体上可能很大，但仍然成为一个约束，因为数千个常驻线程共享它。 ZXNAME0000XZ 当前的计算能力表列出了几种最新架构的每个 ZXNAME0001XZ 64K 32 位寄存器，而 Hopper H100 允许每个线程最多 255 个寄存器。[4][5]
